Project Management

Our project management services keep every stage of your project organized, on schedule, and on budget. From planning and coordination to scheduling, budgeting, and inspections, we manage the details so you can focus on the bigger picture—all with clear communication and a single point of contact.

Our Services

Keeping Projects on Track

Expert project management that keeps your construction project organized, on schedule, and on budget.

From kickoff to final walkthrough, our project managers are there every step of the way. We handle the details—schedules, budgets, trades, and inspections—so you don't have to. It's all about keeping your project organized, on time, and done right the first time.

Our experienced project managers bring decades of commercial construction knowledge to every job. We coordinate all aspects of your project, serving as your single point of contact and ensuring clear communication between all stakeholders, trades, and inspectors.

What's included

  • Detailed project scheduling and timeline management
  • Budget tracking and cost control
  • Trade coordination and supervision
  • Regular progress reporting
  • Quality assurance and inspections
  • Permit coordination
  • Final walkthrough and project closeout

Frequently Asked Questions

Ridgeway Services & Construction primarily serves clients throughout the Greater Toronto Area, Toronto, and Southern Ontario. However, our team has successfully completed projects beyond these areas, including locations across Ontario and Eastern Canada. Whether your project is nearby or requires travel, we're committed to bringing the same level of quality, communication, and expertise to every build.

Ridgeway Services & Construction specializes in commercial construction, renovations, tenant improvements, and design-build projects across a variety of industries. We've worked with businesses in childcare, retail, restaurants, offices, and professional spaces to bring their ideas from concept through completion.

Our team takes a collaborative approach, working closely with clients and partners to deliver high-quality spaces that meet their needs, timelines, and goals.

Yes, Ridgeway Services & Construction offers both design and construction services. Our team works closely with clients to create comprehensive solutions tailored to their needs and goals.

Yes. Ridgeway offers ongoing maintenance and support services after project completion. Our team helps clients maintain their commercial spaces through routine upkeep, repairs, and improvements, ensuring their investment continues to perform well over time.
